$description: Typography composite tokens — bundled type styles that apply font family, weight, size, and line height in one token. Mirrors the type styles in src/assets/css/global/base/global-styles.css. Inner values reference atomic tokens from fonts.json / textWeights.json / textSizes.json / textLeading.json so any change cascades. PENPOT-ONLY FILE: tailwind.config.js does not read this, so nothing here reaches the CSS. That is why letterSpacing carries a bare number that does NOT match the stylesheet — the CSS uses ch units, which Penpot has no equivalent for, so the Penpot value is matched by eye instead. Do not 'correct' these to the CSS numbers; the two sides are deliberately unlinked. Only heading.1 was matched by eye (verified 2026-08-22, 0.7% off the CSS -0.04ch); heading.2 and heading.3 are heading.1 scaled by font size, so confirm them the first time one appears on a board.
